subject: info-algn
title: INFO.ALGN.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 77 ((AF)D-5). INFO-ALGN (information alignment) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: DEC (decentralization) and TR-DEF (trans-definition). From DEC: IST-F (isolated focus). From TR-DEF: LANG-DY (language dynamics) and STF (source transfer). From IST-F: P-PROG (particular progressionalism). From STF: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics).
